description: This file defines an embedded API for interacting with a Superset dashboard, including functions to get scroll size, dashboard permalink, active tabs, data mask, chart states, and chart data payloads.

methods.name: getScrollSize
methods.description: Returns the current size of the document's scrollable area.

methods.name: getDashboardPermalink
methods.description: Asynchronously generates a permalink URL for the dashboard, including optional chart state.

methods.name: getActiveTabs
methods.description: Retrieves the list of active tabs from the dashboard state.

methods.name: getDataMask
methods.description: Retrieves the current data mask state.

methods.name: getChartDataPayloads
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches chart data payloads, optionally filtered by chart ID.
